entities.summary: United Arab Emirates is a sovereign nation in West Asia, Asia. Its capital is Abu Dhabi. Official languages include Arabic. Government: Federal absolute monarchy (7 emirates). Population: approximately 9.9 million. Area: 83,600 km².
